_template_metadata.description: Template for analyzing why architecture diverged from design
_template_metadata.part_of: Reflow v3.15.0 - Architecture Synchronization Loop feature

_root_cause_categories.requirements_creep: New or changed requirements discovered during implementation/testing
_root_cause_categories.performance_optimization: Original design could not meet performance requirements
_root_cause_categories.technical_constraints: Design was impossible or impractical to implement due to technical limitations
_root_cause_categories.security_hardening: Security requirements not fully addressed in original design
_root_cause_categories.developer_mistake: Implementation deviated from design unintentionally (oversight or misunderstanding)

_confidence_levels.high: Clear evidence linking delta changes to this root cause
_confidence_levels.medium: Probable root cause based on available evidence
_confidence_levels.low: Possible root cause, needs further investigation
